description: Golden evaluation set for the groundedkb MCP knowledge base (synthetic Northbridge Analytics corpus). Each entry defines the question, expected answer, and the exact source document + fragment that should be cited. Entries with type='trick_no_answer' verify that the system does NOT fabricate an answer when the information isn't in the corpus.

items.question: How many business days of vacation do I get per year?
items.expected_answer: 15 business days per calendar year, prorated during the first year.
items.expected_fragment: All full-time employees accrue 15 business days of vacation per calendar year

items.question: If I don't use all my vacation days this year, how many can I carry over to next year?
items.expected_answer: Up to a maximum of 5 days; the rest is forfeited on December 31 unless HR authorizes otherwise.
items.expected_fragment: Unused days may be carried over from one year to the next up to a maximum of 5 days

items.question: How far in advance do I need to request my vacation?
items.expected_answer: At least 10 business days in advance, with approval from the direct manager.
items.expected_fragment: must be submitted at least 10 business days in advance

items.question: How many days do I need to work from the office under the hybrid schedule?
items.expected_answer: 3 days in-office and 2 days remote per week.
items.expected_fragment: 3 days of in-office work and 2 days of remote work per week

items.question: How much is the monthly home-office stipend, and do I need to submit receipts to get it?
items.expected_answer: 50 USD per month (or local currency equivalent); no receipts required.
items.expected_fragment: monthly stipend of 50 USD... does not require submitting receipts

items.question: How long is the probationary period, and how many performance check-ins does it include?
items.expected_answer: 90 calendar days, with at least two formal check-ins: at day 30 and at day 75.
items.expected_fragment: The probationary period lasts 90 calendar days... at least two formal performance check-ins: one at day 30 and another at day 75

items.question: Within how many days do I need to enroll in benefits as a new hire?
items.expected_answer: Within the first 30 days of joining; otherwise you must wait for the July open enrollment period.
items.expected_fragment: within the first 30 days of joining... wait for the next open enrollment period, which occurs every July

items.question: What's the term of the CloudTech Solutions contract, and how much notice is needed to terminate it early?
items.expected_answer: Initial term of 24 months; early termination requires written notice at least 60 days in advance.
items.expected_fragment: initial term of 24 months... written notice at least 60 days in advance

items.question: What penalty applies if CloudTech's uptime SLA drops below 99.9%?
items.expected_answer: A service credit of 5% of the monthly invoice per percentage point below the threshold, cumulative up to 25% of the invoice.
items.expected_fragment: a service credit equal to 5% of the value of the corresponding monthly invoice... cumulative up to a maximum of 25%

items.question: Under the HelpDesk Partners contract, how quickly must a critical incident be responded to?
items.expected_fragment: Critical: response within a maximum of 4 hours

items.question: How long does the confidentiality obligation with HelpDesk Partners last after the contract ends?
items.expected_answer: 3 years after termination of the agreement.
items.expected_fragment: remains in effect for 3 years after termination of this agreement

items.question: How do I reset my corporate password, and how long do I have before the link expires?
items.expected_answer: Through portal.northbridge.internal/reset; the link expires in 15 minutes.
items.expected_fragment: The reset link expires in 15 minutes

items.question: What's the daily meal reimbursement limit for business travel, and what happens if an employee spends a bit over that limit with justification?
items.expected_answer: 75 USD per day; if exceeded, it requires additional justification and manager approval (not an automatic rejection).
items.expected_fragment: meal reimbursement limit during business travel is 75 USD per day... Expenses exceeding this limit require additional justification and manager approval

items.question: Within how many business days is a whistleblower report investigated?
items.expected_answer: Within a maximum of 20 business days of receipt.
items.expected_fragment: investigated within a maximum of 20 business days of receipt

items.question: How many days of parental leave does the company offer?
items.expected_answer: Not specified in the available documents; the system should state it doesn't have that information rather than inventing a number.

items.question: What's the annual performance bonus, and in what month is it paid?
items.expected_answer: Not specified in the available documents; the system should state it doesn't have that information rather than inventing a number or date.
